claims: Graco is recalling specific SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seat bases as of April 2026.
The recall is due to a structural defect discovered during post-production testing.
Affected models were sold between January and March 2026 at major retailers, including Amazon, Target, and Walmart.
Affected products model is SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats.
Manufacture dates of affected products are January 2026 – March 2026.
Model number and serial number are on the white sticker on the base.
Graco Consumer Services contact number is 1-800-345-4109.
